data.description:
## Bug Report

When sub-agents write .test-index RED markers for new test files, they append the marker without including the test file path, producing malformed entries like:
  runner.py: ...[existing tests]...,[test_some_marker]
instead of the correct format:
  runner.py: ...[existing tests]...,tests/path/test_file.py [test_some_marker]

This caused harvest-worktree.sh to fail: test-gate-status=failed but failed_tests was empty (record-test-status tolerated all RED failures but harvest's red-exempt check requires non-empty failed_tests).

Root cause: sub-agents don't understand the .test-index format requirement that the test file path MUST precede the [marker].

Impact: Orchestrator had to manually fix .test-index entries and rewrite test-gate-status for 3 out of 4 sub-agents in this batch.

Priority: 2 (high) — blocks batch harvesting silently

Workaround: Orchestrator manually fixes .test-index entries and rewrites test-gate-status to passed when all failures are RED-zone tolerated.
data.title: Sub-agents write malformed .test-index RED marker entries missing test file path
